items.name: The Bahamas Cube Challenge 2026
items.information:
The first WCA competition in the Bahamas! 

#### This competition will serve as the 2026 Bahamas National Championship. The fastest Bahamian competitor in the 3x3 event will be crowned the National Champion of the Bahamas.

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. The competition is open to all competitors of all ages and nationalities. Registration is available on the WCA website. No experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should familiarize themselves with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/).

WCA 공인 대회에 처음 참가 하신다면, 참가 신청 전에 [첫 참가자 안내](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KoreaTemplate2099#66188-for-new-competitors) 탭과 [자주 묻는 질문](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KoreaTemplate2099#66187-frequently-asked-questions) 탭을 확인하십시오.

모든 참가자가 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/)을 숙지할 것을 강력히 권장합니다.

WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다.

원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [대회 참가 안내 영상](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc)을 시청하여 주십시오.

원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오.

___

If this is your first official WCA competition, please read the [For New Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KoreaTemplate2099#66188-for-new-competitors) tab and the [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KoreaTemplate2099#66187-frequently-asked-questions) tab before registering.

All competitors are strongly encouraged to be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

Due to WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties at the organizers' request.

Please watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc) to get familiar with WCA official competitions.

Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz) to get familiar with staff duties.

items.name: Porten til Ishavet 2026
items.information:
## 🇳🇴 Informasjon
Velkommen til Tromsø og Nord-Norge for første gang på 8 år! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta.

### Nye Deltakere
Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese  [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PortentilIshavet2026#26554-nye-konkurrenter-new-competitors).

---

## 🇺🇸 Information
Welcome to to Tromsø and Northern Norway for the first time in 8 years! This competition is open to everyone who wants to compete.

### New Competitors
There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PortentilIshavet2026#26554-nye-konkurrenter-new-competitors) tab.

items.name: Two Buffalo Cube Days 2026

venue.name: [IronWorkers Banquet Hall](https://www.ironworkershall.com/)
venue.address: 196 Orchard Park Rd, West Seneca, NY 14224

items.information:
Western New York's first ever 2-day competition! We're excited to continue expanding speedcubing here!

All competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competition Procedures tab.

**Saturday events:** 4x4x4 Cube, 5x5x5 Cube, 6x6x6 Cube, 7x7x7 Cube, Clock, Megaminx, Square-1
**Sunday events:** 3x3x3 Cube, 2x2x2 Cube, 3x3x3 One-Handed, Pyraminx, Skewb

There will be photography/videography taken at this competition. **By entering this competition, you consent to being photographed and/or filmed for the photographer's use.**

#### From the organizers that brought you SacCubing, comes SacQuiet Fall 2025! 

#### **This competition will be specializing in quiet events and will not have 3x3 or any traditional events.** If you would like to sign up for a competition involving those events, please check out [SacCubing XXII 2026,](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SacCubingXXII2026/) happening on January 18th, the day after.

*  *If we run ahead of schedule, we will start first round events no earlier than 20 minutes, so please show up at least 20 minutes before your first event.*
* We will be assigning judging assignments to competitors for the group before or after their own competing groups. Please check your personal competitor cards when we assign them a week before the competition date for relevant info.
* All donations are appreciated and will go towards things such as venue fees, supplies and other competition expenses.

items.name: Georgia Championship 2026
items.information:
Welcome to the first Georgia state championship in over 7 years! 
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTE3NDc5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--a2840abe3cbbe7f8ef231c927a56475766ca92c7/GeorgiaChampionship26_GC_Patch.png)
All competitors who officially [declare their residency on their CubingUSA account](https://cubingusa.org/edit) in Georgia by **Thursday, January 8, 2026 at 7:00 PM Eastern** will be eligible for Georgia Champion titles. Please note that you may be asked to verify your residency at the competition with identifying documentation if you achieve a Georgia Champion title.

By entering the competition venue, you consent to potentially being videotaped and broadcasted, and you agree to not set up your own livestream or live broadcast of the competition. Please remember as well that outside food is not allowed in the venue.

This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about), the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast! Please check out the [Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GeorgiaChampionship2026#62006-southeast-cubing-inc) to learn more about the organization and what you can do to support the mission.
